verses.original: נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֗א לְֽכָל־ עַֽמְמַיָּ֞א אֻמַיָּ֧א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֛א דִּֽי־ דָאֲרִין בְּכָל־ אַרְעָ֖א שְׁלָמְכ֥וֹן יִשְׂגֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mal·kā lə·ḵāl ‘am·may·yā ’u·may·yā wə·liš·šā·nay·yā dî- ḏå̄·ʾă·rīn bə·ḵāl ’ar·‘ā šə·lā·mə·ḵō·wn yiś·gê
verses.literal: King Nebuchadnezzar To the people of every nation and language who dwell in all the earth May your prosperity be multiplied
verses.literalPt: NABUCODONOSOR rei, a todos os povos, nações e línguas, que moram em toda a terra: Paz vos seja multiplicada.

verses.original: אָֽתַיָּא֙ וְתִמְהַיָּ֔א דִּ֚י עֲבַ֣ד עִמִּ֔י אֱלָהָ֖א עִלָּיָא שְׁפַ֥ר קָֽדָמַ֖י לְהַחֲוָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ṯay·yā wə·ṯim·hay·yā dî ‘ă·ḇaḏ ‘im·mî ’ĕ·lā·hā ʿil·lå̄·yå̄ šə·p̄ar qā·ḏā·may lə·ha·ḥă·wā·yāh
verses.literal: I am pleased . . . to declare the signs and wonders that the Most High God has performed for me
verses.literalPt: Pareceu-me bem fazer conhecidos os sinais e maravilhas que Deus, o Altíssimo, tem feito para comigo.

verses.original: אָת֙וֹהִי֙ כְּמָ֣ה רַבְרְבִ֔ין וְתִמְה֖וֹהִי כְּמָ֣ה תַקִּיפִ֑ין מַלְכוּתֵהּ֙ מַלְכ֣וּת עָלַ֔ם וְשָׁלְטָנֵ֖הּ עִם־ דָּ֥ר וְדָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ṯō·w·hî kə·māh raḇ·rə·ḇîn wə·ṯim·hō·w·hî kə·māh ṯaq·qî·p̄în mal·ḵū·ṯêh mal·ḵūṯ ‘ā·lam wə·šā·lə·ṭā·nêh ‘im- dār wə·ḏār
verses.literal: How great are His signs how mighty His wonders His kingdom is an eternal kingdom His dominion endures from generation to generation
verses.literalPt: Quão grandes são os seus sinais, e quão poderosas as suas maravilhas! O seu reino é um reino sempiterno, e o seu domínio de geração em geração.

verses.original: אֲנָ֣ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר שְׁלֵ֤ה הֲוֵית֙ בְּבֵיתִ֔י וְרַעְנַ֖ן בְּהֵיכְלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nāh nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar šə·lêh hă·wêṯ bə·ḇê·ṯî wə·ra‘·nan bə·hê·ḵə·lî
verses.literal: I Nebuchadnezzar was at ease in my house and flourishing in my palace
verses.literalPt: Eu, Nabucodonosor, estava sossegado em minha casa, e próspero no meu palácio.

verses.original: חֵ֥לֶם חֲזֵ֖ית וִֽידַחֲלִנַּ֑נִי וְהַרְהֹרִין֙ עַֽל־ מִשְׁכְּבִ֔י וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖י יְבַהֲלֻנַּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥê·lem ḥă·zêṯ wî·ḏa·ḥă·lin·na·nî wə·har·hō·rîn ‘al- miš·kə·ḇî wə·ḥez·wê rê·šî yə·ḇa·hă·lun·na·nî
verses.literal: I had a dream and it frightened me while I was in my bed the images and visions in my mind alarmed me
verses.literalPt: Tive um sonho, que me espantou; e estando eu na minha cama, as imaginações e as visões da minha cabeça me turbaram.

verses.original: וּמִנִּי֙ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵ֔ם לְהַנְעָלָ֣ה קָֽדָמַ֔י לְכֹ֖ל חַכִּימֵ֣י בָבֶ֑ל דִּֽי־ פְשַׁ֥ר חֶלְמָ֖א יְהֽוֹדְעֻנַּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min·nî śîm ṭə·‘êm lə·han·‘ā·lāh qā·ḏā·may lə·ḵōl ḥak·kî·mê ḇā·ḇel dî- p̄ə·šar ḥel·mā yə·hō·wḏ·‘un·na·nî
verses.literal: So I issued a decree that all the wise men of Babylon be brought before me to interpret the dream for me
verses.literalPt: Por isso expedi um decreto, para que fossem introduzidos à minha presença todos os sábios de Babilônia, para que me fizessem saber a interpretação do sonho.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֣יִן עָלֲלִין חַרְטֻמַיָּא֙ אָֽשְׁפַיָּ֔א כַּשְׂדָּיֵא וְגָזְרַיָּ֑א וְחֶלְמָ֗א אָמַ֤ר אֲנָה֙ קֳדָ֣מֵיה֔וֹן וּפִשְׁרֵ֖הּ לָא־ מְהוֹדְעִ֥ין לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin ʿå̄·lă·līn ḥar·ṭu·may·yā ’ā·šə·p̄ay·yā kaś·då̄·yē wə·ḡā·zə·ray·yā wə·ḥel·mā ’ā·mar ’ă·nāh qo·ḏā·mê·hō·wn ū·p̄iš·rêh lā- mə·hō·wḏ·‘în lî
verses.literal: When the magicians enchanters astrologers and diviners came in I . . . told them the dream but they could not interpret it for me
verses.literalPt: Então entraram os magos, os astrólogos, os caldeus e os adivinhadores, e eu contei o sonho diante deles; mas não me fizeram saber a sua interpretação.

verses.original: וְעַ֣ד אָחֳרֵ֡ין עַל֩ קָֽדָמַ֨י דָּנִיֵּ֜אל דִּֽי־ שְׁמֵ֤הּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר֙ כְּשֻׁ֣ם אֱלָהִ֔י וְדִ֛י רֽוּחַ־ אֱלָהִ֥ין קַדִּישִׁ֖ין בֵּ֑הּ וְחֶלְמָ֖א קָֽדָמ֥וֹהִי אַמְרֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘aḏ ’ā·ḥo·rên ‘al qā·ḏā·may dā·nî·yêl dî- šə·mêh bê·lə·ṭə·šaṣ·ṣar kə·šum ’ĕ·lā·hî wə·ḏî rū·aḥ- ’ĕ·lā·hîn qad·dî·šîn bêh wə·ḥel·mā qā·ḏā·mō·w·hî ’am·rêṯ
verses.literal: But at last into my presence came Daniel whose name is Belteshazzar after the name of my god and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods And I told him the dream . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas por fim entrou na minha presença Daniel, cujo nome é Beltessazar, segundo o nome do meu deus, e no qual há o espírito dos deuses santos; e eu lhe contei o sonho, dizendo:

verses.original: בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר֮ רַ֣ב חַרְטֻמַיָּא֒ דִּ֣י׀ אֲנָ֣ה יִדְעֵ֗ת דִּ֠י ר֣וּחַ אֱלָהִ֤ין קַדִּישִׁין֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְכָל־ רָ֖ז לָא־ אָנֵ֣ס לָ֑ךְ חֶזְוֵ֨י חֶלְמִ֧י דִֽי־ חֲזֵ֛ית וּפִשְׁרֵ֖הּ אֱמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bê·lə·ṭə·šaṣ·ṣar raḇ ḥar·ṭu·may·yā dî ’ă·nāh yiḏ·‘êṯ dî rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lā·hîn qad·dî·šîn bāḵ wə·ḵāl rāz lā- ’ā·nês lāḵ ḥez·wê ḥel·mî ḏî- ḥă·zêṯ ū·p̄iš·rêh ’ĕ·mar
verses.literal: O Belteshazzar chief of the magicians I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and that no mystery baffles you So explain to me the visions I saw in my dream and their interpretation
verses.literalPt: Beltessazar, mestre dos magos, pois eu sei que há em ti o espírito dos deuses santos, e nenhum mistério te é difícil, dize-me as visões do meu sonho que tive e a sua interpretação.

verses.original: וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖י עַֽל־ מִשְׁכְּבִ֑י חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית וַאֲל֥וּ אִילָ֛ן בְּג֥וֹא אַרְעָ֖א וְרוּמֵ֥הּ שַׂגִּֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥez·wê rê·šî ‘al- miš·kə·ḇî ḥā·zêh hă·wêṯ wa·’ă·lū ’î·lān bə·ḡō·w ’ar·‘ā wə·rū·mêh śag·gî
verses.literal: In these visions of my mind as I was lying in bed I saw this come to pass There was a tree in the midst of the land and its height was great
verses.literalPt: Eis, pois, as visões da minha cabeça, estando eu na minha cama: Eu estava assim olhando, e vi uma árvore no meio da terra, cuja altura era grande;

verses.original: רְבָ֥ה אִֽילָנָ֖א וּתְקִ֑ף וְרוּמֵהּ֙ יִמְטֵ֣א לִשְׁמַיָּ֔א וַחֲזוֹתֵ֖הּ לְס֥וֹף כָּל־ אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ḇāh ’î·lā·nā ū·ṯə·qip̄ wə·rū·mêh yim·ṭê liš·may·yā wa·ḥă·zō·w·ṯêh lə·sō·wp̄ kāl- ’ar·‘ā
verses.literal: The tree grew large and strong its top reached the sky and it was visible to the ends . . . of the earth
verses.literalPt: Crescia esta árvore, e se fazia forte, de maneira que a sua altura chegava até ao céu; e era vista até aos confins da terra.

verses.original: עָפְיֵ֤הּ שַׁפִּיר֙ וְאִנְבֵּ֣הּ שַׂגִּ֔יא וּמָז֨וֹן לְכֹ֖לָּא־ בֵ֑הּ תְּחֹת֜וֹהִי תַּטְלֵ֣ל׀ חֵיוַ֣ת בָּרָ֗א וּבְעַנְפ֙וֹהִי֙ יְדֻרוּן צִפֲּרֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א וּמִנֵּ֖הּ יִתְּזִ֥ין כָּל־ בִּשְׂרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·p̄ə·yêh šap·pîr wə·’in·bêh śag·gî ū·mā·zō·wn lə·ḵōl·lā- ḇêh tə·ḥō·ṯō·w·hî taṭ·lêl ḥê·waṯ bā·rā ū·ḇə·‘an·p̄ō·w·hî yə·ḏu·rūn ṣip·pă·rê šə·may·yā ū·min·nêh yit·tə·zîn kāl- biś·rā
verses.literal: Its leaves were beautiful its fruit was abundant and upon it was food for all Under it the beasts of the field found shelter in its branches the birds of the air nested and from it every creature was fed
verses.literalPt: A sua folhagem era formosa, e o seu fruto abundante, e havia nela sustento para todos; debaixo dela os animais do campo achavam sombra, e as aves do céu faziam morada nos seus ramos, e toda a carne se mantinha dela.

verses.original: חָזֵ֥ה הֲוֵ֛ית בְּחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖י עַֽל־ מִשְׁכְּבִ֑י וַאֲלוּ֙ עִ֣יר וְקַדִּ֔ישׁ מִן־ שְׁמַיָּ֖א נָחִֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zêh hă·wêṯ bə·ḥez·wê rê·šî ‘al- miš·kə·ḇî wa·’ă·lū ‘îr wə·qad·dîš min- šə·may·yā nā·ḥiṯ
verses.literal: As I lay on my bed . . . I also saw . . . in the visions of my mind a watcher a holy one coming down from heaven
verses.literalPt: Estava vendo isso nas visões da minha cabeça, estando eu na minha cama; e eis que um vigia, um santo, descia do céu,

verses.original: קָרֵ֨א בְחַ֜יִל וְכֵ֣ן אָמַ֗ר גֹּ֤דּוּ אִֽילָנָא֙ וְקַצִּ֣צוּ עַנְפ֔וֹהִי אַתַּ֥רוּ עָפְיֵ֖הּ וּבַדַּ֣רוּ אִנְבֵּ֑הּ תְּנֻ֤ד חֵֽיוְתָא֙ מִן־ תַּחְתּ֔וֹהִי וְצִפְּרַיָּ֖א מִן־ עַנְפֽוֹהִי׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rê ḇə·ḥa·yil wə·ḵên ’ā·mar gōd·dū ’î·lā·nā wə·qaṣ·ṣi·ṣū ‘an·p̄ō·w·hî ’at·ta·rū ‘ā·p̄ə·yêh ū·ḇad·da·rū ’in·bêh tə·nuḏ ḥê·wə·ṯā min- taḥ·tō·w·hî wə·ṣip·pə·ray·yā min- ‘an·p̄ō·w·hî
verses.literal: He called out in a loud voice . . . . . . Cut down the tree and chop off its branches strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit Let the beasts flee from under it and the birds from its branches
verses.literalPt: Clamando fortemente, e dizendo assim: Derrubai a árvore, e cortai-lhe os ramos, sacudi as suas folhas, espalhai o seu fruto; afugentem-se os animais de debaixo dela, e as aves dos seus ramos.

verses.original: בְּרַ֨ם עִקַּ֤ר שָׁרְשׁ֙וֹהִי֙ בְּאַרְעָ֣א שְׁבֻ֔קוּ וּבֶֽאֱסוּר֙ דִּֽי־ פַרְזֶ֣ל וּנְחָ֔שׁ בְּדִתְאָ֖א דִּ֣י בָרָ֑א וּבְטַ֤ל שְׁמַיָּא֙ יִצְטַבַּ֔ע וְעִם־ חֵיוְתָ֥א חֲלָקֵ֖הּ בַּעֲשַׂ֥ב אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ram ‘iq·qar šā·rə·šō·w·hî bə·’ar·‘ā šə·ḇu·qū ū·ḇe·’ĕ·sūr dî- p̄ar·zel ū·nə·ḥāš bə·ḏiṯ·’ā dî ḇā·rā ū·ḇə·ṭal šə·may·yā yiṣ·ṭab·ba‘ wə·‘im- ḥê·wə·ṯā ḥă·lā·qêh ba·‘ă·śaḇ ’ar·‘ā
verses.literal: But leave the stump with its roots in the ground with a band of iron and bronze around it in the tender grass of the field Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven and graze with the beasts on the grass of the earth
verses.literalPt: Mas deixai na terra o tronco com as suas raízes, atada com cadeias de ferro e de bronze, na erva do campo; e seja molhado do orvalho do céu, e seja a sua porção com os animais na erva da terra;

verses.original: לִבְבֵהּ֙ מִן־ אֱנוֹשָׁא יְשַׁנּ֔וֹן וּלְבַ֥ב חֵיוָ֖ה יִתְיְהִ֣ב לֵ֑הּ וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֥וּן עֲלֽוֹהִי׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·ḇêh min- ʾɛ̆·nō·šå̄ yə·šan·nō·wn ū·lə·ḇaḇ ḥê·wāh yiṯ·yə·hiḇ lêh wə·šiḇ·‘āh ‘id·dā·nîn yaḥ·lə·p̄ūn ‘ă·lō·w·hî
verses.literal: Let his mind be changed from that of a man and let him be given the mind of a beast till seven times pass him by
verses.literalPt: Seja mudado o seu coração, para que não seja mais coração de homem, e lhe seja dado coração de animal; e passem sobre ele sete tempos.

verses.original: בִּגְזֵרַ֤ת עִירִין֙ פִּתְגָמָ֔א וּמֵאמַ֥ר קַדִּישִׁ֖ין שְׁאֵֽלְתָ֑א עַד־ דִּבְרַ֡ת דִּ֣י יִנְדְּע֣וּן חַ֠יַּיָּא דִּֽי־ שַׁלִּ֨יט עִלָּיָא בְּמַלְכ֣וּת אֱנוֹשָׁא וּלְמַן־ דִּ֤י יִצְבֵּא֙ יִתְּנִנַּ֔הּ וּשְׁפַ֥ל אֲנָשִׁ֖ים יְקִ֥ים עֲלַיַּהּ׃
verses.transliteration: biḡ·zê·raṯ ‘î·rîn piṯ·ḡā·mā ū·mê·mar qad·dî·šîn šə·’ê·lə·ṯā ‘aḏ- diḇ·raṯ dî yin·də·‘ūn ḥay·yay·yā dî- šal·lîṭ ʿil·lå̄·yå̄ bə·mal·ḵūṯ ʾɛ̆·nō·šå̄ ū·lə·man- dî yiṣ·bê yit·tə·nin·nah ū·šə·p̄al ’ă·nā·šîm yə·qîm ʿă·lay·yah
verses.literal: This decision is the decree of the watchers the verdict declared by the holy ones so that . . . . . . the living will know that the Most High rules over the kingdom of mankind and gives it to whom . . . He wishes setting over it the lowliest of men
verses.literalPt: Esta sentença é por decreto dos vigias, e esta ordem por mandado dos santos, a fim de que conheçam os viventes que o Altíssimo tem domínio sobre o reino dos homens, e o dá a quem quer, e até ao mais humilde dos homens constitui sobre ele.

verses.original: דְּנָה֙ חֶלְמָ֣א חֲזֵ֔ית אֲנָ֖ה מַלְכָּ֣א נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֑ר וְאַנְתָּה בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֜ר פִּשְׁרֵ֣א׀ אֱמַ֗ר כָּל־ קֳבֵל֙ דִּ֣י׀ כָּל־ חַכִּימֵ֣י מַלְכוּתִ֗י לָֽא־ יָכְלִ֤ין פִּשְׁרָא֙ לְהוֹדָ֣עֻתַ֔נִי וְאַנְתָּה כָּהֵ֔ל דִּ֛י רֽוּחַ־ אֱלָהִ֥ין קַדִּישִׁ֖ין בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: də·nāh ḥel·mā ḥă·zêṯ ’ă·nāh mal·kā nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar wə·ʾan·tå̄h bê·lə·ṭə·šaṣ·ṣar piš·rê ’ĕ·mar kāl- qo·ḇêl dî kāl- ḥak·kî·mê mal·ḵū·ṯî lā- yā·ḵə·lîn piš·rā lə·hō·w·ḏā·‘u·ṯa·nî wə·ʾan·tå̄h kā·hêl dî rū·aḥ- ’ĕ·lā·hîn qad·dî·šîn bāḵ
verses.literal: This is the dream that I King Nebuchadnezzar saw Now Belteshazzar tell me the interpretation because . . . none of the wise men of my kingdom can interpret it for me But you are able because the spirit of the holy gods is in you
verses.literalPt: Este sonho eu, rei Nabucodonosor vi. Tu, pois, Beltessazar, dize a interpretação, porque todos os sábios do meu reino não puderam fazer-me saber a sua interpretação, mas tu podes; pois há em ti o espírito dos deuses santos.

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן דָּֽנִיֵּ֜אל דִּֽי־ שְׁמֵ֣הּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֗ר אֶשְׁתּוֹמַם֙ כְּשָׁעָ֣ה חֲדָ֔ה וְרַעְיֹנֹ֖הִי יְבַהֲלֻנֵּ֑הּ עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜א וְאָמַ֗ר בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר֙ חֶלְמָ֤א וּפִשְׁרֵא֙ אַֽל־ יְבַהֲלָ֔ךְ עָנֵ֤ה בֵלְטְשַׁאצַּר֙ וְאָמַ֔ר מָרְאִי חֶלְמָ֥א לְשָׂנְאַיִךְ וּפִשְׁרֵ֥הּ לְעָרַיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin dā·nî·yêl dî- šə·mêh bê·lə·ṭə·šaṣ·ṣar ’eš·tō·w·mam kə·šā·‘āh ḥă·ḏāh wə·ra‘·yō·nō·hî yə·ḇa·hă·lun·nêh ‘ā·nêh mal·kā wə·’ā·mar bê·lə·ṭə·šaṣ·ṣar ḥel·mā ū·p̄iš·rê ’al- yə·ḇa·hă·lāḵ ‘ā·nêh ḇê·lə·ṭə·šaṣ·ṣar wə·’ā·mar må̄·rə·ʾī ḥel·mā lə·śå̄·nə·ʾa·yiḵ ū·p̄iš·rêh lə·ʿå̄·ra·yiḵ
verses.literal: For a time Daniel who was also known as Belteshazzar was perplexed and his thoughts alarmed him So the king . . . said Belteshazzar do not let the dream or its interpretation alarm you My lord . . . replied Belteshazzar may the dream apply to those who hate you and its interpretation to your enemies
verses.literalPt: Então Daniel, cujo nome era Beltessazar, esteve atônito por uma hora, e os seus pensamentos o turbavam; falou, pois, o rei, dizendo: Beltessazar, não te espante o sonho, nem a sua interpretação. Respondeu Beltessazar, dizendo: SENHOR meu, seja o sonho contra os que te têm ódio, e a sua interpretação aos teus inimigos.

verses.original: אִֽילָנָא֙ דִּ֣י חֲזַ֔יְתָ דִּ֥י רְבָ֖ה וּתְקִ֑ף וְרוּמֵהּ֙ יִמְטֵ֣א לִשְׁמַיָּ֔א וַחֲזוֹתֵ֖הּ לְכָל־ אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·lā·nā dî ḥă·zay·ṯā dî rə·ḇāh ū·ṯə·qip̄ wə·rū·mêh yim·ṭê liš·may·yā wa·ḥă·zō·w·ṯêh lə·ḵāl ’ar·‘ā
verses.literal: The tree you saw that grew large and strong whose top reached the sky and was visible to all the earth
verses.literalPt: A árvore que viste, que cresceu, e se fez forte, cuja altura chegava até ao céu, e que foi vista por toda a terra;

verses.original: וְעָפְיֵ֤הּ שַׁפִּיר֙ וְאִנְבֵּ֣הּ שַׂגִּ֔יא וּמָז֨וֹן לְכֹ֖לָּא־ בֵ֑הּ תְּחֹת֗וֹהִי תְּדוּר֙ חֵיוַ֣ת בָּרָ֔א וּבְעַנְפ֕וֹהִי יִשְׁכְּנָ֖ן צִפֲּרֵ֥י שְׁמַיָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·p̄ə·yêh šap·pîr wə·’in·bêh śag·gî ū·mā·zō·wn lə·ḵōl·lā- ḇêh tə·ḥō·ṯō·w·hî tə·ḏūr ḥê·waṯ bā·rā ū·ḇə·‘an·p̄ō·w·hî yiš·kə·nān ṣip·pă·rê šə·may·yā
verses.literal: whose foliage was beautiful and whose fruit was abundant providing food for all under which the beasts of the field lived and in whose branches the birds of the air nested
verses.literalPt: Cujas folhas eram formosas, e o seu fruto abundante, e em que para todos havia sustento, debaixo da qual moravam os animais do campo, e em cujos ramos habitavam as aves do céu;

verses.original: אַנְתָּה ה֣וּא מַלְכָּ֔א דִּ֥י רְבַ֖ית וּתְקֵ֑פְתְּ וּרְבוּתָ֤ךְ רְבָת֙ וּמְטָ֣ת לִשְׁמַיָּ֔א וְשָׁלְטָנָ֖ךְ לְס֥וֹף אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ʾan·tå̄h hū mal·kā dî rə·ḇayṯ ū·ṯə·qê·p̄ət ū·rə·ḇū·ṯāḵ rə·ḇāṯ ū·mə·ṭāṯ liš·may·yā wə·šā·lə·ṭā·nāḵ lə·sō·wp̄ ’ar·‘ā
verses.literal: you O king are that tree . . . For you have become great and strong your greatness has grown to reach the sky and your dominion extends to the ends of the earth
verses.literalPt: És tu, ó rei, que cresceste, e te fizeste forte; a tua grandeza cresceu, e chegou até ao céu, e o teu domínio até à extremidade da terra.

verses.original: וְדִ֣י חֲזָ֣ה מַלְכָּ֡א עִ֣יר וְקַדִּ֣ישׁ נָחִ֣ת׀ מִן־ שְׁמַיָּ֡א וְאָמַר֩ גֹּ֨דּוּ אִֽילָנָ֜א וְחַבְּל֗וּהִי בְּרַ֨ם עִקַּ֤ר שָׁרְשׁ֙וֹהִי֙ בְּאַרְעָ֣א שְׁבֻ֔קוּ וּבֶאֱסוּר֙ דִּֽי־ פַרְזֶ֣ל וּנְחָ֔שׁ בְּדִתְאָ֖א דִּ֣י בָרָ֑א וּבְטַ֧ל שְׁמַיָּ֣א יִצְטַבַּ֗ע וְעִם־ חֵיוַ֤ת בָּרָא֙ חֲלָקֵ֔הּ עַ֛ד דִּֽי־ שִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֥וּן עֲלֽוֹהִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏî ḥă·zāh mal·kā ‘îr wə·qad·dîš nā·ḥiṯ min- šə·may·yā wə·’ā·mar gōd·dū ’î·lā·nā wə·ḥab·bə·lū·hî bə·ram ‘iq·qar šā·rə·šō·w·hî bə·’ar·‘ā šə·ḇu·qū ū·ḇe·’ĕ·sūr dî- p̄ar·zel ū·nə·ḥāš bə·ḏiṯ·’ā dî ḇā·rā ū·ḇə·ṭal šə·may·yā yiṣ·ṭab·ba‘ wə·‘im- ḥê·waṯ bā·rā ḥă·lā·qêh ‘aḏ dî- šiḇ·‘āh ‘id·dā·nîn yaḥ·lə·p̄ūn ‘ă·lō·w·hî
verses.literal: And you, O king saw a watcher a holy one coming down from heaven and saying Cut down the tree and destroy it but leave the stump with its roots in the ground with a band of iron and bronze around it in the tender grass of the field Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven and graze with the beasts of the field till . . . seven times pass him by
verses.literalPt: E quanto ao que viu o rei, um vigia, um santo, que descia do céu, e dizia: Cortai a árvore, e destruí-a, mas o tronco com as suas raízes deixai na terra, e atada com cadeias de ferro e de bronze, na erva do campo; e seja molhado do orvalho do céu, e a sua porção seja com os animais do campo, até que passem sobre ele sete tempos;

verses.original: דְּנָ֥ה פִשְׁרָ֖א מַלְכָּ֑א וּגְזֵרַ֤ת עִלָּיָא הִ֔יא דִּ֥י מְטָ֖ת עַל־ מַרְאִי מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: də·nāh p̄iš·rā mal·kā ū·ḡə·zê·raṯ ʿil·lå̄·yå̄ hî dî mə·ṭāṯ ‘al- mar·ʾī mal·kā
verses.literal: This is the interpretation O king and this is the decree that the Most High . . . has issued against my lord the king
verses.literalPt: Esta é a interpretação, ó rei; e este é o decreto do Altíssimo, que virá sobre o rei, meu senhor:

verses.original: וְלָ֣ךְ טָֽרְדִ֣ין מִן־ אֲנָשָׁ֡א וְעִם־ חֵיוַ֣ת בָּרָא֩ לֶהֱוֵ֨ה מְדֹרָ֜ךְ וְעִשְׂבָּ֥א כְתוֹרִ֣ין׀ לָ֣ךְ יְטַֽעֲמ֗וּן וּמִטַּ֤ל שְׁמַיָּא֙ לָ֣ךְ מְצַבְּעִ֔ין וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֣וּן עֲלָ֑יךְ עַ֣ד דִּֽי־ תִנְדַּ֗ע דִּֽי־ שַׁלִּ֤יט עִלָּיאָ֙ בְּמַלְכ֣וּת אֲנָשָׁ֔א וּלְמַן־ דִּ֥י יִצְבֵּ֖א יִתְּנִנַּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lāḵ ṭā·rə·ḏîn min- ’ă·nā·šā wə·‘im- ḥê·waṯ bā·rā le·hĕ·wêh mə·ḏō·rāḵ wə·‘iś·bā ḵə·ṯō·w·rîn lāḵ yə·ṭa·‘ă·mūn ū·miṭ·ṭal šə·may·yā lāḵ mə·ṣab·bə·‘în wə·šiḇ·‘āh ‘id·dā·nîn yaḥ·lə·p̄ūn ʿă·lå̄yḵ ‘aḏ dî- ṯin·da‘ dî- šal·lîṭ ʿil·lå̄y·ʾå̄ bə·mal·ḵūṯ ’ă·nā·šā ū·lə·man- dî yiṣ·bê yit·tə·nin·nah
verses.literal: You will be driven away from mankind and your dwelling will be with the beasts of the field You will feed on grass like an ox and be drenched with the dew of heaven and seven times shall pass you by until . . . you acknowledge that the Most High rules over the kingdom of mankind and gives it to whom . . . He wishes
verses.literalPt: Serás tirado dentre os homens, e a tua morada será com os animais do campo, e te farão comer erva como os bois, e serás molhado do orvalho do céu; e passar-se-ão sete tempos por cima de ti; até que conheças que o Altíssimo tem domínio sobre o reino dos homens, e o dá a quem quer.

verses.original: וְדִ֣י אֲמַ֗רוּ לְמִשְׁבַּ֞ק עִקַּ֤ר שָׁרְשׁ֙וֹהִי֙ דִּ֣י אִֽילָנָ֔א מַלְכוּתָ֖ךְ לָ֣ךְ קַיָּמָ֑ה מִן־ דִּ֣י תִנְדַּ֔ע דִּ֥י שַׁלִּטִ֖ן שְׁמַיָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏî ’ă·ma·rū lə·miš·baq ‘iq·qar šā·rə·šō·w·hî dî ’î·lā·nā mal·ḵū·ṯāḵ lāḵ qay·yā·māh min- dî ṯin·da‘ dî šal·li·ṭin šə·may·yā
verses.literal: As for the command to leave the stump of the tree with its roots your kingdom will be restored to you as soon as you acknowledge that Heaven rules
verses.literalPt: E quanto ao que foi falado, que deixassem o tronco com as raízes da árvore, o teu reino voltará para ti, depois que tiveres conhecido que o céu reina.

verses.original: לָהֵ֣ן מַלְכָּ֗א מִלְכִּי֙ יִשְׁפַּ֣ר עֲלַיִךְ וַחֲטָיָךְ בְּצִדְקָ֣ה פְרֻ֔ק וַעֲוָיָתָ֖ךְ בְּמִחַ֣ן עֲנָ֑יִן הֵ֛ן תֶּהֱוֵ֥א אַרְכָ֖ה לִשְׁלֵוְתָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·hên mal·kā mil·kî yiš·par ʿă·la·yiḵ wa·ḥă·ṭå̄·yå̄ḵ bə·ṣiḏ·qāh p̄ə·ruq wa·‘ă·wā·yā·ṯāḵ bə·mi·ḥan ‘ă·nā·yin hên te·hĕ·wê ’ar·ḵāh liš·lê·wə·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: Therefore may my advice be pleasing to you O king Break away from your sins by doing what is right and from your iniquities by showing mercy to the oppressed Perhaps there will be an extension of your prosperity
verses.literalPt: Portanto, ó rei, aceita o meu conselho, e põe fim aos teus pecados, praticando a justiça, e às tuas iniqüidades, usando de misericórdia com os pobres, pois, talvez se prolongue a tua tranqüilidade.

verses.original: כֹּ֣לָּא מְּטָ֔א עַל־ נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מַלְכָּֽא׃פ
verses.transliteration: kōl·lā mə·ṭā ‘al- nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mal·kā
verses.literal: All this happened to King Nebuchadnezzar
verses.literalPt: Todas estas coisas vieram sobre o rei Nabucodonosor.

verses.original: לִקְצָ֥ת יַרְחִ֖ין תְּרֵֽי־ עֲשַׂ֑ר עַל־ הֵיכַ֧ל מַלְכוּתָ֛א דִּ֥י בָבֶ֖ל מְהַלֵּ֥ךְ הֲוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: liq·ṣāṯ yar·ḥîn tə·rê- ‘ă·śar ‘al- hê·ḵal mal·ḵū·ṯā dî ḇā·ḇel mə·hal·lêḵ hă·wāh
verses.literal: Twelve . . . months later as he was walking on the roof of the royal palace . . . of Babylon
verses.literalPt: Ao fim de doze meses, quando passeava no palácio real de Babilônia,

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה מַלְכָּא֙ וְאָמַ֔ר הֲלָ֥א דָא־ הִ֖יא בָּבֶ֣ל רַבְּתָ֑א דִּֽי־ אֲנָ֤ה בֱנַיְתַהּ֙ לְבֵ֣ית מַלְכ֔וּ בִּתְקַ֥ף חִסְנִ֖י וְלִיקָ֥ר הַדְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·nêh mal·kā wə·’ā·mar hă·lā ḏā- hî bā·ḇel rab·bə·ṯā dî- ’ă·nāh ḇĕ·nay·ṯah lə·ḇêṯ mal·ḵū biṯ·qap̄ ḥis·nî wə·lî·qār haḏ·rî
verses.literal: the king . . . exclaimed Is this . . . not Babylon the Great which I myself have built as a royal residence by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty
verses.literalPt: Falou o rei, dizendo: Não é esta a grande Babilônia que eu edifiquei para a casa real, com a força do meu poder, e para glória da minha magnificência?

verses.original: ע֗וֹד מִלְּתָא֙ בְּפֻ֣ם מַלְכָּ֔א קָ֖ל מִן־ שְׁמַיָּ֣א נְפַ֑ל לָ֤ךְ אָֽמְרִין֙ נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֔א מַלְכוּתָ֖ה עֲדָ֥ת מִנָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ mil·lə·ṯā bə·p̄um mal·kā qāl min- šə·may·yā nə·p̄al lāḵ ’ā·mə·rîn nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mal·kā mal·ḵū·ṯāh ‘ă·ḏāṯ min·nāḵ
verses.literal: While the words were still in the king’s mouth a voice came from heaven It is decreed to you King Nebuchadnezzar that the kingdom has departed from you
verses.literalPt: Ainda estava a palavra na boca do rei, quando caiu uma voz do céu: A ti se diz, ó rei Nabucodonosor: Passou de ti o reino.

verses.original: וּמִן־ אֲנָשָׁא֩ לָ֨ךְ טָֽרְדִ֜ין וְֽעִם־ חֵיוַ֧ת בָּרָ֣א מְדֹרָ֗ךְ עִשְׂבָּ֤א כְתוֹרִין֙ לָ֣ךְ יְטַעֲמ֔וּן וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה עִדָּנִ֖ין יַחְלְפ֣וּן עִלַיִךְ עַ֣ד דִּֽי־ תִנְדַּ֗ע דִּֽי־ שַׁלִּ֤יט עִלָּיאָ֙ בְּמַלְכ֣וּת אֲנָשָׁ֔א וּלְמַן־ דִּ֥י יִצְבֵּ֖א יִתְּנִנַּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- ’ă·nā·šā lāḵ ṭā·rə·ḏîn wə·‘im- ḥê·waṯ bā·rā mə·ḏō·rāḵ ‘iś·bā ḵə·ṯō·w·rîn lāḵ yə·ṭa·‘ă·mūn wə·šiḇ·‘āh ‘id·dā·nîn yaḥ·lə·p̄ūn ʿi·la·yiḵ ‘aḏ dî- ṯin·da‘ dî- šal·lîṭ ʿil·lå̄y·ʾå̄ bə·mal·ḵūṯ ’ă·nā·šā ū·lə·man- dî yiṣ·bê yit·tə·nin·nah
verses.literal: You will be driven away from mankind to live with the beasts of the field and you will feed on grass like an ox And seven times will pass you by until . . . you acknowledge that the Most High rules over the kingdom of mankind and gives it to whom . . . He wishes
verses.literalPt: E serás tirado dentre os homens, e a tua morada será com os animais do campo; far-te-ão comer erva como os bois, e passar-se-ão sete tempos sobre ti, até que conheças que o Altíssimo domina sobre o reino dos homens, e o dá a quem quer.

verses.original: בַּהּ־ שַׁעֲתָ֗א מִלְּתָא֮ סָ֣פַת עַל־ נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר֒ וּמִן־ אֲנָשָׁ֣א טְרִ֔יד וְעִשְׂבָּ֤א כְתוֹרִין֙ יֵאכֻ֔ל וּמִטַּ֥ל שְׁמַיָּ֖א גִּשְׁמֵ֣הּ יִצְטַבַּ֑ע עַ֣ד דִּ֥י שַׂעְרֵ֛הּ כְּנִשְׁרִ֥ין רְבָ֖ה וְטִפְר֥וֹהִי כְצִפְּרִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: bah- ša·‘ă·ṯā mil·lə·ṯā sā·p̄aṯ ‘al- nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar ū·min- ’ă·nā·šā ṭə·rîḏ wə·‘iś·bā ḵə·ṯō·w·rîn yê·ḵul ū·miṭ·ṭal šə·may·yā giš·mêh yiṣ·ṭab·ba‘ ‘aḏ dî śa‘·rêh kə·niš·rîn rə·ḇāh wə·ṭip̄·rō·w·hî ḵə·ṣip·pə·rîn
verses.literal: At that moment the sentence against Nebuchadnezzar was fulfilled He was driven away from mankind He ate grass like an ox and his body was drenched with the dew of heaven until . . . his hair grew like the feathers of an eagle and his nails like the claws of a bird
verses.literalPt: Na mesma hora se cumpriu a palavra sobre Nabucodonosor, e foi tirado dentre os homens, e comia erva como os bois, e o seu corpo foi molhado do orvalho do céu, até que lhe cresceu pêlo, como as penas da águia, e as suas unhas como as das aves.

verses.original: וְלִקְצָ֣ת יֽוֹמַיָּה֩ אֲנָ֨ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֜ר עַיְנַ֣י׀ לִשְׁמַיָּ֣א נִטְלֵ֗ת וּמַנְדְּעִי֙ עֲלַ֣י יְת֔וּב וּלְעִלָּיָא בָּרְכֵ֔ת וּלְחַ֥י עָלְמָ֖א שַׁבְּחֵ֣ת וְהַדְּרֵ֑ת דִּ֤י שָׁלְטָנֵהּ֙ שָׁלְטָ֣ן עָלַ֔ם וּמַלְכוּתֵ֖הּ עִם־ דָּ֥ר וְדָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liq·ṣāṯ yō·w·may·yāh ’ă·nāh nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar ‘ay·nay liš·may·yā niṭ·lêṯ ū·man·də·‘î ‘ă·lay yə·ṯūḇ ū·lə·ʿil·lå̄·yå̄ bā·rə·ḵêṯ ū·lə·ḥay ‘ā·lə·mā šab·bə·ḥêṯ wə·had·də·rêṯ dî šā·lə·ṭā·nêh šā·lə·ṭān ‘ā·lam ū·mal·ḵū·ṯêh ‘im- dār wə·ḏār
verses.literal: But at the end of those days I Nebuchadnezzar looked up . . . to heaven and my sanity was restored to me Then I praised the Most High and I honored and glorified . . . Him who lives forever For His dominion is an everlasting dominion and His kingdom endures from generation to generation
verses.literalPt: Mas ao fim daqueles dias eu, Nabucodonosor, levantei os meus olhos ao céu, e tornou-me a vir o entendimento, e eu bendisse o Altíssimo, e louvei e glorifiquei ao que vive para sempre, cujo domínio é um domínio sempiterno, e cujo reino é de geração em geração.

verses.original: וְכָל־ דָּאֲרֵי אַרְעָא֙ כְּלָ֣ה חֲשִׁיבִ֔ין וּֽכְמִצְבְּיֵ֗הּ עָבֵד֙ בְּחֵ֣יל שְׁמַיָּ֔א וְדָאֲרֵי אַרְעָ֑א וְלָ֤א אִיתַי֙ דִּֽי־ יְמַחֵ֣א בִידֵ֔הּ וְיֵ֥אמַר לֵ֖הּ מָ֥ה עֲבַֽדְתְּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl då̄·ʾă·rē ’ar·‘ā kə·lāh ḥă·šî·ḇîn ū·ḵə·miṣ·bə·yêh ‘ā·ḇêḏ bə·ḥêl šə·may·yā wə·ḏå̄·ʾă·rē ’ar·‘ā wə·lā ’î·ṯay dî- yə·ma·ḥê ḇî·ḏêh wə·yê·mar lêh māh ‘ă·ḇaḏt
verses.literal: All the peoples of the earth are counted as nothing and He does as He pleases with the army of heaven and the peoples of the earth There is no one who can restrain His hand or say to Him What have You done
verses.literalPt: E todos os moradores da terra são reputados em nada, e segundo a sua vontade ele opera com o exército do céu e os moradores da terra; não há quem possa estorvar a sua mão, e lhe diga: Que fazes?

verses.original: בֵּהּ־ זִמְנָ֞א מַנְדְּעִ֣י׀ יְת֣וּב עֲלַ֗י וְלִיקַ֨ר מַלְכוּתִ֜י הַדְרִ֤י וְזִוִי֙ יְת֣וּב עֲלַ֔י וְלִ֕י הַדָּֽבְרַ֥י וְרַבְרְבָנַ֖י יְבַע֑וֹן וְעַל־ מַלְכוּתִ֣י הָתְקְנַ֔ת וּרְב֥וּ יַתִּירָ֖ה ה֥וּסְפַת לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bêh- zim·nā man·də·‘î yə·ṯūḇ ‘ă·lay wə·lî·qar mal·ḵū·ṯî haḏ·rî wə·zi·wî yə·ṯūḇ ‘ă·lay wə·lî had·dā·ḇə·ray wə·raḇ·rə·ḇā·nay yə·ḇa·‘ō·wn wə·‘al- mal·ḵū·ṯî hā·ṯə·qə·naṯ ū·rə·ḇū yat·tî·rāh hū·sə·p̄aṯ lî
verses.literal: At the same time my sanity was restored my honor and splendor returned to me for the glory of my kingdom My advisers and nobles sought me out and I was restored to my throne and surpassing greatness was added to me
verses.literalPt: No mesmo tempo tornou a mim o meu entendimento, e para a dignidade do meu reino tornou-me a vir a minha majestade e o meu resplendor; e buscaram-me os meus conselheiros e os meus senhores; e fui restabelecido no meu reino, e a minha glória foi aumentada.

verses.original: כְּעַ֞ן אֲנָ֣ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר מְשַׁבַּ֨ח וּמְרוֹמֵ֤ם וּמְהַדַּר֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ שְׁמַיָּ֔א דִּ֤י כָל־ מַעֲבָד֙וֹהִי֙ קְשֹׁ֔ט וְאֹרְחָתֵ֖הּ דִּ֑ין וְדִי֙ מַהְלְכִ֣ין בְּגֵוָ֔ה יָכִ֖ל לְהַשְׁפָּלָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kə·‘an ’ă·nāh nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mə·šab·baḥ ū·mə·rō·w·mêm ū·mə·had·dar lə·me·leḵ šə·may·yā dî ḵāl ma·‘ă·ḇā·ḏō·w·hî qə·šōṭ wə·’ō·rə·ḥā·ṯêh dîn wə·ḏî mah·lə·ḵîn bə·ḡê·wāh yā·ḵil lə·haš·pā·lāh
verses.literal: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and exalt and glorify the King of heaven for all His works are true and all His ways are just And He is able to humble those who walk in pride
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, eu, Nabucodonosor, louvo, exalço e glorifico ao Rei do céu; porque todas as suas obras são verdade, e os seus caminhos juízo, e pode humilhar aos que andam na soberba.
